source: Frozen libsodium-wrappers-sumo Argon2id outputs with our production parameters (opslimit=4, memlimit=256 MiB, parallelism=1). See kek.test.ts comment for the regenerable CLI command. These are the same trust-class as the Argon2id KAT in @truecairn/crypto — they verify our wrapper is calling Argon2id with the locked params and have not silently changed.

releasePassphraseSharePerCallSaltConstru.comment: Per-call salt = crypto_kdf_derive_from_key(extendedKey=BLAKE2b256(baseSalt), ctx='tc-relsl', subkey_id=(tier_byte<<8)|shareIndex, len=16). The KAT pins BOTH the intermediate per-call salt AND the final share bytes. If a regression accidentally reuses the base salt for two different (tier, shareIndex) calls, the per-call salts would collide; pinning the intermediate makes that visible.
